chunks: O Lord, Owner of all dominion, You give dominion to whom You will, and You take away dominion from whom You will; You exalt whom You please and debase whom You will. All goodness is in Your hand. Indeed, You have power over all things.

key_terms.بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ: All goodness is in Your hand

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Du'a al-Malik in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is frequently cited as the foundational text for Du'a al-Malik, recited by the Imams to affirm divine sovereignty over political and spiritual authority. It underscores the concept that true power and honor are bestowed by God alone, serving as a reminder of His omnipotence and the transient nature of worldly dominion.
